gameDescriptionHtml:
1000 Deaths is a gravity-bending 3D platformer where your choices matter. Encounter several unique platforming hubs based on the decisions you make. Switch between 4 playable characters as the story progresses and follow them from birth to death.

Game Features

  • Puzzle and Action Platforming – Run, jump, and dash across walls, floors, and ceilings because gravity reorients itself as you play. Encounter a variety of cerebral puzzles and action-packed challenges. The only constant is the constantly changing gravity!
  • You Choose Their Fates – Play as one of four whimsical characters and help them make life-altering decisions. Build friendships, become a rockstar, rule as a corporate bigwig, or mess up your love life! Your choices also define the mechanics of the platforming levels you run into.
  • Discover Surreal Spaces and Characters – Interact with a world populated by talking egg yolks, sentient squiggles, and mysterious beings in purple suits. Explore sleepy Nowherestown and glitzy Jollywood, meander through the psychedelic Headspaces to find hidden collectibles and bonus levels.
  • Master Speedrunning, or Don’t! – You can speedrun through each level of 1000 Deaths and earn trophies! Try to get the fastest time in the 45+ Arcade levels. Or, play at the pace you want.
